name: Shorts Studio
description: Turns a source kit into a scroll-stopping short video and its cover: picks the angle and hook (problem to solution, before/after, list, express demo, conviction), writes the script screen by screen and gets it approved, then renders with Remotion a 9:16 video (and a 4:5 feed version) in the brand's colors, fonts and logo — product screenshots in phone or browser frames, demo clips, animated numbers, highlighted words, music — plus marketing covers (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9 thumbnail) with short, punchy titles. Checks every file against each network's limits and reviews the frames before handing over.
